title: Bit cruncher
description: Do you hate your ears? This is the right mod for you
body:
This mod attempts to replicate the "bitcrunch" effect used in audio... it doesn't do it well.

Think loud is funny? want to add this to a pack to prank your friends? this is the right mod for you!

The mod dynamically tries to bitcrunch the audio of the game, it comes with config for the bitrate, samplerate division and gain.

Game must be restarted for config options to apply!
